description: This file defines TypeScript types, interfaces, and constants for the communication protocol between components in the 'playwright' project, specifically related to various channels, events, and data structures. It contains type declarations for channels, events, and utility types used throughout the system.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: Represents a webpage, providing methods to interact with the page such as navigation, input simulation, screenshot capture, event handling, and more.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a frame within a page, offering methods for evaluating scripts, querying elements, and controlling frame-specific actions.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a worker context, allowing evaluation of scripts and subscription to events within a worker.

classes.name: JSHandle
classes.description: A handle to a JavaScript object, used for evaluating expressions, retrieving properties, and managing the lifecycle of the object.

classes.name: ElementHandle
classes.description: A handle to a DOM element, subclass of JSHandle with additional element-specific methods such as click, type, hover, etc.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request initiated by the page, with methods to access request details and response.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a network route, providing control over interception, aborting, or fulfilling requests.

classes.name: WebSocketRoute
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket route, allowing message interception, sending, and connection management.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, exposing methods to access response data and security details.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection, enabling sending and receiving messages, with event handlers for connection states.

classes.name: BindingCall
classes.description: Represents a call to a bound function from the page context, allowing resolution or rejection.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a dialog prompt (alert, confirm, prompt), with methods to accept or dismiss.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: Provides methods to start and stop tracing, capturing performance and activity data.

classes.name: DialogEventTarget
classes.description: Empty interface representing dialog event target.

classes.name: DialogChannel
classes.description: Extends DialogEventTarget and Channel, providing methods to accept and dismiss dialogs, with associated params and results.

classes.name: TracingEventTarget
classes.description: Empty interface representing tracing event target.

classes.name: TracingChannel
classes.description: Extends TracingEventTarget and Channel, offering methods to start, stop, group, and manage tracing chunks and results.

classes.name: ArtifactEventTarget
classes.description: Empty interface representing artifact event target.

classes.name: ArtifactChannel
classes.description: Extends ArtifactEventTarget and Channel, providing methods to handle artifacts such as saving, deleting, streaming, and failure reporting.

classes.name: StreamEventTarget
classes.description: Empty interface representing stream event target.

classes.name: StreamChannel
classes.description: Extends StreamEventTarget and Channel, with methods to read from and close streams.

classes.name: WritableStreamEventTarget
classes.description: Empty interface representing writable stream event target.

classes.name: WritableStreamChannel
classes.description: Extends WritableStreamEventTarget and Channel, providing methods to write data and close the stream.

classes.name: CDPSessionEventTarget
classes.description: Extends CDPSessionEventTarget, enabling event handling for CDP sessions.

classes.name: CDPSessionChannel
classes.description: Extends CDPSessionEventTarget and Channel, capable of sending and detaching CDP commands.

classes.name: ElectronEventTarget
classes.description: Extends ElectronEventTarget, representing Electron event target.

classes.name: ElectronChannel
classes.description: Extends ElectronEventTarget and Channel, providing methods for Electron app launch with various parameters.

classes.name: ElectronApplicationEventTarget
classes.description: Extends ElectronApplicationEventTarget, representing Electron application events.

classes.name: ElectronApplicationChannel
classes.description: Extends ElectronApplicationEventTarget and EventTargetChannel, offering methods to manage Electron applications, evaluate expressions, and access browser windows.

classes.name: AndroidEventTarget
classes.description: Extends AndroidEventTarget, representing Android device event target.

classes.name: AndroidChannel
classes.description: Extends AndroidEventTarget and Channel, providing methods to interact with Android devices and enumerate connected devices.

classes.name: AndroidSocketEventTarget
classes.description: Extends AndroidSocketEventTarget, handling data and close events.

classes.name: AndroidSocketChannel
classes.description: Extends AndroidSocketEventTarget and Channel, capable of writing data and closing socket connections.

classes.name: AndroidDeviceEventTarget
classes.description: Extends AndroidDeviceEventTarget, representing event target for Android devices.

classes.name: AndroidDeviceChannel
classes.description: Extends AndroidDeviceEventTarget and EventTargetChannel, with methods for device interactions such as input, screenshot, shell, install APK, connect WebView, etc.

classes.name: JsonPipeEventTarget
classes.description: Extends JsonPipeEventTarget, handling message and closed events.

classes.name: JsonPipeChannel
classes.description: Extends JsonPipeEventTarget and Channel, with methods for message passing and closing.

classes.name: PageAgentEventTarget
classes.description: Extends PageAgentEventTarget, representing page agent event target.

classes.name: PageAgentChannel
classes.description: Extends PageAgentEventTarget and EventTargetChannel, providing methods to perform, expect, extract, dispose, and monitor usage of page automation tasks.

methods.name: resolveLocatorHandlerNoReply
methods.description: Resolves a locator handler identified by UID, potentially removing it.

methods.name: unregisterLocatorHandler
methods.description: Unregisters a locator handler specified by UID.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the page with optional timeout and waitUntil conditions.

methods.name: expectScreenshot
methods.description: Performs a screenshot comparison against expected, with timeout and comparison parameters.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the page, with options for format, quality, clip, background, etc.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets additional HTTP headers for subsequent requests.

methods.name: setNetworkInterceptionPatterns
methods.description: Defines URL patterns for network request interception.

methods.name: setWebSocketInterceptionPatterns
methods.description: Defines URL patterns for WebSocket interception.

methods.name: setViewportSize
methods.description: Sets the viewport size for the page.

methods.name: keyboardDown
methods.description: Simulates pressing down a key.

methods.name: keyboardUp
methods.description: Simulates releasing a key.

methods.name: keyboardInsertText
methods.description: Inserts text via keyboard input.

methods.name: keyboardType
methods.description: Types text with specified delay.

methods.name: keyboardPress
methods.description: Presses and releases a key with optional delay.

methods.name: mouseMove
methods.description: Moves the mouse cursor to specified coordinates.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Simulates mouse button press.

methods.name: mouseUp
methods.description: Simulates mouse button release.

methods.name: mouseClick
methods.description: Performs a click at specified coordinates.

methods.name: mouseWheel
methods.description: Simulates mouse wheel scroll.

methods.name: touchscreenTap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on the touchscreen.

methods.name: pageErrors
methods.description: Retrieves page error logs.

methods.name: pdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF of the page content with specified options.

methods.name: requests
methods.description: Returns network requests made by the page.

methods.name: snapshotForAI
methods.description: Captures a snapshot for AI processing.

methods.name: startJSCoverage
methods.description: Starts JavaScript code coverage collection.

methods.name: stopJSCoverage
methods.description: Stops JavaScript coverage collection and retrieves coverage data.

methods.name: startCSSCoverage
methods.description: Starts CSS coverage collection.

methods.name: stopCSSCoverage
methods.description: Stops CSS coverage collection and retrieves coverage data.

methods.name: bringToFront
methods.description: Brings the page to the foreground.

methods.name: updateSubscription
methods.description: Updates event subscription for the page.

methods.name: agent
methods.description: Provides an agent interface for automation or AI integration.
